_comment: Copy to .databricks/bundle/prod/variable-overrides.json and fill in your values. Path is gitignored. The workspace host comes from your databricks CLI profile (or DATABRICKS_HOST env var), not this file.
_branding_comment: Optional top-left branding. Leave app_logo_url blank to keep the built-in icon. To use a custom logo, drop the image in frontend/public/ (e.g. frontend/public/brand-logo.png) and set app_logo_url to its served path (/brand-logo.png); a logo/asset change needs a rebuild (FORCE_BUILD=1 ./deploy.sh).
